description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 07.12.2015 to 13.12.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and specifically sets new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory matter under customs law, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) as it establishes compliance requirements for import/export transactions and formally rescinds previous exchange rate regulations.
